title: QUAKE III ARENA
subtitle: id Software, 1999 · 1.32b, the GPL source — Linux/GLX, OpenGL only, interpreted QVMs
argsHint: `+map <name>` loads an arena (q3dm1 to q3dm19, q3tourney1..6, q3ctf1..4); without it the game opens on its menu. com_introplayed 1 skips the id logo film. The build's own flags (interpreted VMs, no UDP, an impure local server) come from the target and stay.
_fps: 85 is the engine's own cap, com_maxfps's default in qcommon/common.c.

needsData.hint: baseq3/ of the full game: pak0.pk3 from the CD and pak1-8 from the 1.32 point release

_why: The first id engine with no software renderer: tr_*.c speaks only OpenGL, here PRISM's, opened by linux_qgl.c with dlopen("libGL.so.1"). The game, cgame and ui modules run as QVM bytecode in the engine's own interpreter, compiled by PRISM like the rest.
